claims.evidence: The witness report identifies the item as an engine and gearbox assembly but could not confirm the brand or model.
No import documentation or shipping labels are visible in the report.
Static photos of an unmounted engine cannot demonstrate internal mechanical health or functional status.
The witness noted that mileage is not shown.
Close-up photos of factory seals on the head and block are missing.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (engine knock or seized components).
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result for each cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: As a core unit requiring a full rebuild.

risks.risk: Transmission or transfer case failure (slipping gears or internal damage).
risks.proof: A video showing the unit shifting through gears or a technician's diagnostic report.
risks.if_unproven: As non-functional units for parts only.

risks.risk: Incorrect model fitment (not a 3.6L Pentastar V6).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block identification code or the VIN plate from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: As an unidentified generic engine assembly.

risks.risk: Locally salvaged unit being sold as imported (Tokunbo).
risks.proof: Original import clearing documents or a bill of lading.
risks.if_unproven: As a locally used unit with higher wear expectations.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block casting numbers or identification stamps.
Photos of the factory seals on the engine head and transmission pan.
Video of the engine running if possible, or a manual rotation of the crankshaft to ensure it is not seized.
response.reason: The witness was unable to identify the specific make and model of the assembly. Without confirmation that this is the 3.6L Jeep Wrangler unit claimed, a reliable valuation cannot be made.
